lines.text: How's the elbow since last time?
From last time I can lift the kettle without wincing, which is a first.
Grand. And the GP gave you tablets?
So it says ibuprofen 400 milligrams, three times a day after food, for up to ten days.
Have a go at gripping my fingers. That's stronger than last week, about two thirds of the other side.
Keep the slow wrist lowering with the tin of beans, fifteen times, twice a day, it's the lowering part that matters.
Grand so, mind yourself. Same time next week.
I will. Did you see the hurling at the weekend?
I did, sure it was a disaster. Go on, off with you.
Howya, Siobhan, come in, sit yourself down.
Hi. My neck's locked since I slept funny on Tuesday, I can't turn it at all.
